title: Factor Augmented High-Dimensional SGD
abstract: arXiv:2605.19291v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is a fundamental optimization algorithm widely used in modern machine learning. In this paper, we propose Factor-Augmented SGD (FSGD), a new optimization method that leverages latent factor representations in high-dimensional learning tasks. Unlike standard two-stage dimension reduction approaches that rely on offline representation learning and full data storage, a key novelty of FSGD is that it operates purely on streaming data, making it scalable to large-scale and high-dimensional problems. Furthermore, we establish the first theoretical framework that explicitly incorporates latent factor estimation error into the analysis of SGD, and provide moment convergence in $\ell^s$ norm under decaying step sizes and mini-batch updates. Our results provide a new foundation for employing SGD reliably and scalably in high-dimensional machine learning systems.

translated_title: 因子增强的高维随机梯度下降
translated_abstract: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是一种在现代机器学习中广泛应用的基础优化算法。本文提出了因子增强随机梯度下降（FSGD），这是一种新的优化方法，能够在高维学习任务中利用潜在因子表示。与依赖离线表示学习和完整数据存储的标准两阶段降维方法不同，FSGD的一个关键创新在于它完全基于流式数据运行，使其能够扩展到大规模和高维问题。此外，我们建立了首个将潜在因子估计误差显式纳入SGD分析的理论框架，并在衰减步长和小批量更新条件下给出了$\ell^s$范数的矩收敛性结果。我们的成果为在高维机器学习系统中可靠且可扩展地应用SGD提供了新的理论基础。
tldr: 提出了一种完全基于流式数据的因子增强随机梯度下降方法（FSGD），并首次建立了将潜在因子估计误差纳入SGD分析的理论框架，为高维机器学习提供了可靠且可扩展的优化基础。
en_tdlr: Proposes Factor-Augmented SGD (FSGD), a purely streaming-data optimization method leveraging latent factor representations, and establishes the first theoretical framework incorporating latent factor estimation error into SGD analysis with $\ell^s$-norm moment convergence guarantees.
